Your master password never leaves this device. The cloud stores only Argon2-encrypted blocks, so neither the server nor anyone in between can decrypt your vault

Sync credentials are sealed with hardware Keystore encryption, but the sealing key does not require biometric authentication — this ensures background auto-sync works while the device is locked. Credentials are unsealed only during sync and immediately wiped from memory afterward (CharArray borrow semantics + full SigV4 derivation chain zeroing), never persisting as immutable Strings
